verdict.rationale: Lithic is a hosted card-issuing API platform, and self-hosting is a fair openness question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack describes a self-hosted, on-prem, or open-source deployment of the core issuing or processing platform. The docs present it as a managed service (sandbox, hosted APIs, rules 'without managing additional infrastructure'), and the MCP server only gives editor access to the hosted API.
